tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Toolocate directory for AI tools that fit a task, optionally filtered by category, price, platform or agent access. Results come best name match first, then most notable, each with a one-line summary, pricing, platforms, agent access (API, MCP, CLI), the official url and pageUrl, the Tool

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full Toolocate listing of one AI tool: description, features, who it is for, FAQs, pricing plans, platforms, agent access, the official url and pageUrl, the Toolocate page to cite. checkedAt is when we last verified the official site.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find tools that do the same job as a given tool, closest first: tools sharing its main category, then its other categories, ranked by shared categories and tags, then notability. Results have the same fields as search_tools.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category groups and categories that have tools, with tool counts and page URLs. Pass a category slug or group id as the category of search_tools.
